ov: أربع زيجات وجنازة (الإنجليزية: Four Weddings and a Funeral) هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في المملكة المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1994. الفيلم من إخراج مايك نيويل.
plotEn:
Perpetually late Charles and his flatmate, Scarlett, arrive just in time for the wedding of their friends Angus and Laura in Somerset, where Charles is to serve as the best man. Among the guests are their closest friends: Charles's deaf brother David; aristocratic Fiona and her bumbling brother Tom; and exuberant Gareth and his thoughtful partner Matthew. Charles meets an American woman named Carrie at the reception and end up spending the night together. Carrie, who had previously worked in the U.K., laments that they may have "missed a great opportunity" as she leaves for home in the U.S. Bernard and Lydia, two other friends who know each other platonically, hit it off at the reception. A young woman named Serena becomes smitten with David. 
Three months later, Charles and Scarlett are late again, for the wedding of Bernard and Lydia in London. Charles is delighted to encounter Carrie again at the reception, but is disappointed to learn she's engaged to Hamish, a wealthy Scot. He is cornered by several ex-girlfriends, including Henrietta who tells him he's a "serial monogamist" fearful of commitment. Hamish leaves the reception early and Carrie asks Charles to keep her company; they once again spend the night together. Serena, who is learning sign language, tries communicating with David and they dance together.
